title: Goroutine leak from missing cancellation
summary: Starting goroutines without a clear cancellation, timeout, or lifecycle owner.
rationale: Leaked goroutines retain memory, file descriptors, timers, and latent work over time.

detection.notes: Detect go statements lacking context propagation, done channel handling, or bounded lifecycle.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large inputs, high-concurrency services, build pipelines, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Pass context.Context, select on cancellation, close channels deliberately, and make owners responsible for shutdown.
remediation.tradeoffs: Cancellation plumbing adds ceremony but prevents long-running operational decay.
